description: Two real defects: (1) file handle leak in read_value when json.load or the isinstance check raises, and (2) path traversal — both write_value (line 9) and read_value (line 15) interpolate an unsanitized `key` into the file path, so a key containing `../` or an absolute path can escape cache_dir. Live eval surfaced (2) — codex and gemini independently flagged it as critical, which is correct.

defects.description: file handle leaked on exception path; should use `with` context manager
key interpolated into path without sanitization in both write_value (line 9) and read_value (line 15); attacker-controlled key can escape cache_dir
